scope: first-phase independent read-only reports; authenticated definition sharing; exact numeric wire values; dashboards deferred

browser.target: final production nginx + production backend images with real PostgreSQL; the nine initial flows also passed against Cloud development services
checks: independent creation previews a real read-only query and saves a shared chart
view executes the saved definition through the dedicated report route and exposes chart source rows
concurrent edits produce a visible conflict without overwriting the saved definition
line, pie and metric charts render complete real query results without client aggregation
large integers, high precision decimals and JSON cell numbers retain their exact values
truncation is explicit, row 1000 remains reachable, and the mobile page fits the viewport
a real SQL error is visible and does not masquerade as an empty or old result
readonly viewer uses a personal binding and keeps access after the publisher deletes their connection
unbound owner cannot borrow viewer credentials and anonymous sharing remains disabled
all real browser paths finish without page script errors
production nginx proxies readiness to production backend

operational_checks: production audit spool drained before cleanup

boundaries: Report results are live per-viewer queries, not shared cached rows.
At most 1000 rows and 30 seconds per report SQL, subject to stricter server settings.
Browser aggregation, anonymous shares, schedules, exports and dashboard authoring are outside this phase.
Real native PostgreSQL/MySQL and PostgreSQL JDBC were exercised; no new openGauss container or full version matrix was run in this change.
Validation used local Cloud fixtures; production business load, domains and real organization rollout were not exercised.
